messages.subject: Issues with predictions
parts:
Hello! 

I am trying to model the distribution of the African leopard in the Western and Eastern Cape provinces of South Africa. Currently, I am only running the models with bioclimatic variables but I intend to add surface ruggedness and NDVI at a later stage. However, whenever I try predict even the current distribution (using CHELSA climate data), the model predicts presence of the species in the ocean. I have no idea why it's doing this. If anyone has had this problem before and can provide some help/guidance, I would greatly appreciate it. 

Thank you!! see photo attached for reference
